description: This file defines the ModelTree class and its nested classes, modeling a tree widget structure in Apache OFBiz. It includes data structures for tree nodes, sub-nodes, labels, links, images, and conditions, as well as rendering logic for rendering tree strings and node elements. The class is designed to be immutable and read-only, representing the <tree> element from XML configurations.

classes.name: ModelTree
classes.description: Represents a read-only model of a tree widget configured via XML, including nodes, their conditions, actions, rendering styles, and traversal logic.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode
classes.description: Models individual tree nodes including labels, links, actions, conditions, and sub-nodes, with rendering and traversal logic.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Label
classes.description: Represents a label element within a tree node, with text, style, and ID attributes.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Link
classes.description: Represents a hyperlink within a tree node, including parameters, target, style, and associated images.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Image
classes.description: Models an image element within a link, including source, size, style, and ID.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelSubNode
classes.description: Represents a sub-node configuration within a tree node used for nested traversal with its own actions and node name.

methods.name: renderTreeString
methods.description: Renders the entire tree structure into a string, starting from the root node and using the provided TreeStringRenderer.

methods.name: getDefaultEntityName
methods.description: Returns the default entity name associated with the tree.

methods.name: getExpandCollapseRequest
methods.description: Constructs and returns a request string (e.g., for expand/collapse toggle) based on context and configuration.

methods.name: getOpenDepth
methods.description: Returns the open depth configuration indicating how many levels are initially expanded.

methods.name: getPostTrailOpenDepth
methods.description: Returns the post-trail open depth indicating levels after a trail that are open.

methods.name: getRenderStyle
methods.description: Returns the style used for rendering the tree (e.g., simple, expand-collapse).

methods.name: getRootNodeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the root node for the tree.

methods.name: getTrailName
methods.description: Generates the trail name used internally in context for tracking the node trail.

methods.name: getWrapStyle
methods.description: Returns the wrap style configuration for rendering nodes.
